svg.title: Flagship project: Argus
svg.desc: Modular OSINT and reconnaissance framework for public-source research, entity correlation and local reporting. SSRF guard: private-address blocking with pinned DNS against rebinding Redirects re-validated, default response-size cap on every request Archive inspection bounded by member, size and path limits Untrusted content escaped before it reaches Markdown reports
